candidate: Topical APR-246/eprenetapopt for persistent AEC erosions
scope: APR-specific advancement and decision specification; cross-candidate ranking belongs to the independent portfolio reassessment.

decision.disposition: Retain inherited first conditional development option, subject to portfolio comparison and actual scoped terms.
decision.source_pass: Closed after targeted model and published-claim recoveries.
decision.exact_claim: Useful sustained control of persistent AEC erosions and treatment burden during continued use, with acceptable tissue integrity and local/systemic exposure.

historical_envelope.label: Inherited analyst assumption, not a current quote or validated schedule.

gates.question: Is the intended claim and next decision finite?
gates.requirement: Specify the incremental ongoing-control benefit and the choice informed by success, failure or an inconclusive result.
gates.present_evidence: Round16 claim amendment retained; no universal withdrawal-persistence or complete-cornification requirement.

gates.question: Can the historical article be transferred and interpreted without substantial new invention?
gates.requirement: Document identity, essential performance and exposure gaps, transfer feasibility and the cost of resolving consequential gaps.
gates.present_evidence: Defined historical article and nominal consistency retained; no new quantitative finished-article transfer record recovered.
gates.must_be_resolved_before: Interpretation of article-dependent results; qualification may itself be the funded question

gates.question: Is an existing evidence route sufficiently specified for a fit decision?
gates.requirement: Map the source-backed route to the intended question and identify what it cannot establish.
gates.present_evidence: Main text and linked supplement recovered, including controls, exact alleles and replicate units.

gates.question: Are access, model fit and negative-result interpretation actually established?
gates.requirement: Verify actual inputs/access and whether the proposed result can distinguish article failure, insufficient delivery, model limitations and failure of the intended claim.
gates.present_evidence: A published route is not a transferred or APR-responsive assay; no access or cost commitment was recovered.
gates.must_be_resolved_before: A strong result-dependent biological inference; fit qualification can be a separate first block

gates.question: Does APR provide useful comparative ongoing control?
gates.requirement: Evidence appropriate to the intended claim, with useful benefit and tissue/exposure interpretation.
gates.present_evidence: Retained two-child uncontrolled source lineage; no added treatment observation.
gates.must_be_resolved_before: Claiming demonstrated useful efficacy; not a prerequisite for evaluating a bounded proof

gates.question: Are publication claims and commercial control distinguished?
gates.requirement: Keep known published claims, current title/status, territorial constraints, data use and offered terms separate.
gates.present_evidence: Official-source US publication and European procedural record/document list recovered. Text of the listed October 2025 amended EP claims and current assignment/transaction terms remain unverified.
gates.must_be_resolved_before: Any commercial commitment that depends on those rights
gates.retrieval_followup: Specific listed October 2025 two-page claims were targeted through the ordinary public document UI; Firecrawl interaction timed out without claim text. The amended-claim gap remains explicit.

gates.question: Does a priced information purchase beat alternatives and waiting?
gates.requirement: Compare the exact deliverable, total remaining cost, timing, retained interest and option to stop with the strongest available alternative.
gates.present_evidence: No actual offer or executable terms; inherited envelope is not repriced.

next_commitment.goal: Determine whether an existing article and a defined evidence route can deliver consequential information at acceptable all-in terms.
next_commitment.controlled_clinical_route: May be more informative, but requires a separately assessed and authorized scope.

branches.if: Existing article and suitable evidence route can answer a consequential question at acceptable terms
branches.then: Consider that bounded block against current alternatives; no automatic later funding.

branches.if: Initial work supplies transfer/model qualification only
branches.then: Reprice the separate useful-function or clinical decision.

branches.if: Credible useful benefit at interpretable exposure with adequate tissue integrity
branches.then: Consider independent confirmation and the next claim-specific product/capture question.

branches.if: Qualified evidence excludes worthwhile benefit for the specified claim
Inconclusive because article, exposure, model or measurement is inadequate
branches.then: Evaluate a finite informative remedy or stop; do not infer global biological failure.

branches.if: Substantial new invention or inaccessible inputs/rights are required
branches.then: End the small-option premise and compare the revised remaining opportunity with alternatives and cash.

branches.if: Patient benefit can be shown but retained economics are inadequate
branches.then: Decline the commercial thesis at those terms; label any public-benefit route separately.

branches.if: No superior defined and priced opportunity is established
branches.then: Retain capital and await a named substantive reopening event.

reopening_triggers: substantive additional clinical result or correction
text of the listed October 2025 European amended claims, substantive later prosecution, or current assignment record
priced scope changing the marginal-dollar comparison
limitations: No new biological work or clinical evidence.
No calibrated success probability or numerical EV.
No verified current title, FTO or available license.
